title: On Brouwer's Laplacian conjecture
summary: Brouwer's Laplacian conjecture states that the sum of the largest $k$ eigenvalues of a graph's Laplacian is less than or equal to the number of edges plus $\binom{k+1}{2}$. We give a proof of this conjecture. Our proof relies on the Grone--Merris--Bai theorem for \emph{split} graphs. We also show the converse, thereby establishing an equivalence between Brouwer's conjecture and the Grone--Merris--Bai theorem.
